Player names associated with completed runs
Persisted highscore file
Highscore menu presentation
Local highscore file
nodes.sink: Highscore parsing and in-memory record construction
nodes.source: The file supplied to the highscore store
nodes.untrusted_input: User-editable bytes representing stored names, scores, and survival times

nodes.label: Finished level state
nodes.sink: The operation that receives a completed run
nodes.untrusted_input: Score, player identity, and elapsed time derived from a level affected by local or shared level content and cheating

nodes.label: Player-name input
nodes.sink: The operation that receives a new highscore record
nodes.untrusted_input: A locally entered or edited display name

nodes.label: A malformed or tampered local record, name, score, or time could corrupt ranking, misrepresent a player, or prevent the menu from loading.
nodes.task_relevance: The feature introduces a persistent file and accepts locally editable performance data.

nodes.label: The finished-run operation must record the actual completed level score, player name, and elapsed survival time for both clearing and losing, with survival time represented consistently for mm:ss display.
nodes.task_relevance: This is the primary feature behavior at level end.

nodes.label: The record-receiving operation must validate score, survival time, and player name before adding a record; invalid values must be rejected rather than substituted or clamped.
nodes.task_relevance: Prevents malformed or cheated input from entering the ranking.

nodes.label: The caller at run completion must normalize or supply explicit safe defaults for missing or invalid level-derived values before invoking the record-receiving operation, so recording the finished run still occurs.
nodes.task_relevance: Preserves the required recording effect when level state is incomplete.

nodes.label: The in-memory records and their parallel name, score, and survival-time views must remain aligned, and records must be ordered by score descending for every public view and menu presentation.
nodes.task_relevance: Ensures rankings and displayed fields describe the same run.

nodes.label: The store must persist accepted records to the supplied file and reload them across process runs without allowing malformed file content to create partial or misaligned records.
nodes.task_relevance: Provides persistence while protecting the ranking from file corruption.

nodes.label: The dedicated menu panel must display player names, descending scores, and survival times formatted as mm:ss, and must provide a normal route back to the existing menu flow.
nodes.task_relevance: Integrates the highscore board into the desktop game’s navigation and presentation.

nodes.failure_behavior: Reject the invalid file and report the rejection; do not clamp, partially accept, or substitute records.
nodes.label: At the file-reading operation, parse a bounded record count and bounded field sizes, validate each field and record shape, and reject the invalid input with a reported load error.
nodes.task_relevance: Limits resource consumption and prevents malformed persisted data from entering memory.

nodes.failure_behavior: Reject the record and report the rejection without changing stored records.
nodes.label: At the operation that receives a new record, enforce nonnegative bounded numeric values and a bounded, display-safe player name before insertion.
nodes.task_relevance: Protects the ranking and rendering path from invalid run data.

nodes.failure_behavior: Use the stated defaults or normalization and continue recording; do not skip the finished run.
nodes.label: At the level-end integration point, choose explicit safe defaults or normalized values for missing or invalid level-derived score, name, or elapsed time before calling the record operation.
nodes.task_relevance: Ensures the primary record-run effect occurs even when game state is incomplete.

nodes.failure_behavior: Reject the whole update if the fields cannot remain aligned; retain the prior valid collection.
nodes.label: Use one bounded record collection or an equivalent coordinated update mechanism so names, scores, and survival times are inserted, sorted, exposed, and persisted together.
nodes.task_relevance: Prevents field misalignment and inconsistent rankings.

nodes.failure_behavior: Report the write failure and retain the in-memory accepted record for the current run without treating uncommitted data as persisted.
nodes.label: At persistence, write validated records using a deterministic format and replace or commit the target file atomically where practical, avoiding executable or object-deserialization facilities.
nodes.task_relevance: Reduces corruption and avoids dangerous interpretation of user-editable files.

nodes.failure_behavior: Show an empty or safely truncated board and report invalid data rather than failing the entire menu.
nodes.label: At panel initialization and rendering, consume only validated bounded records, format elapsed seconds as mm:ss, and reuse ApoIcarus’s ranking and paging presentation pattern adapted to ApoMario’s menu model.
nodes.task_relevance: Provides a safe dedicated view while maximizing donor implementation reuse.

summary: Add a local, persistent highscore store, a finished-run recording step, and a dedicated menu panel. Reuse ApoIcarus’s record model, sorting, formatting, and panel-navigation concepts while adapting persistence to the supplied file path and ApoMario’s level lifecycle.
